description: Resolve a selected builtin component-library card using its exact collection, id and revision. Returns the canonical pinned document and source snapshots for a preset or recipe, or the exact source for a definition. Preserve documentSha256 and all identities; a missing revision refuses without falling back to another version or scope. Resolve before apply_template; do not invent wrapper source or reconstruct a package from a thumbnail.
name: resolve_builtin_component
title: Resolve Builtin Component
